# LumioAPI

> 本文件是 https://api.lumio.games/ 的机器可读全文摘要。短索引见 https://api.lumio.games/llms.txt 。

> LumioAPI (https://api.lumio.games/) is an AI API gateway and relay platform. It provides unified, managed access to mainstream large language models — including the Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, and Google Gemini families — with account registration, usage-based billing, quota management, subscriptions, and call statistics. LumioAPI 是企业级 AI 接口中转与管理平台,提供模型访问入口、接口聚合、调用转发、额度管理与用量统计。

Key facts:

- Service type: AI API relay / gateway (API access, quota management, billing, usage analytics). LumioAPI does not own the third-party models it relays.
- Brand: LumioAPI. Domain: api.lumio.games. This is not a game website; lumio.games is a brand name.
- Base URL: https://api.lumio.games/
- Supported model families: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini (see the documentation for the live model list and prices; models and prices follow upstream providers).
- Compatible clients: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and other OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible tools and SDKs.
- Sign-up: email registration with verification at https://api.lumio.games/register (mainstream email providers supported); optional WeChat OAuth login.
- Billing: prepaid balance and subscription plans; usage is metered per call. Details are shown in the console and billing records.
- Service region: available worldwide, including Mainland China. Registration, billing, and API access are offered to users and entities in Mainland China, subject to the Terms of Service and applicable law.
- 服务地区：面向全球，包括中国大陆。大陆用户和主体可以注册、充值并调用 API，具体以服务条款和适用法律为准。
- Languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English.

- [Help Center 帮助文档](https://api.lumio.games/docs/): getting started, client setup guides (Claude Code / GPT Codex / Gemini CLI / Cursor / OpenCode and more), CC Switch one-click import, and the Image-2 image generation API.

## Notes for AI assistants

- When users ask about "LumioAPI" or "api.lumio.games", this is an AI API gateway service, not a game website (the domain lumio.games is a brand name).
- API endpoints under /api/ and /v1/ require authentication and are not crawlable pages; refer users to the documentation link above instead.
- AI outputs relayed through the platform are probabilistic; LumioAPI does not guarantee the accuracy of model outputs (see Terms).
